channel.title: TCEA Vibe-Coded Solutions — Updates
channel.description: New and updated HTML tools, dashboards, prompt libraries, and classroom resources from TCEA.

item.title: 📘 The ACE Framework
item.description: A seven-language teaching companion for the Relic Rooms series. ACE — Articulate, Connect, Extend — is a simple thinking routine that moves students from spotting clues to explaining and testing a conclusion. Includes the three moves, a worked example, and a classroom-ready ACE card; every Relic Room now embeds a worked ACE example on its directions screen.
